title: Category Reassessment Figure: Assembly and Rounding (Insurance Claim Services)
content:
**Pricing clause.** For an Insurance Claim Services category reassessment supplement, the reassessment figure adds up the line-family differences of the Water Damage Mitigation job, each priced from the Water Damage Mitigation rates for the tier the recorded category and the job's affected area select — Standard Loss below the 2000 square foot Large Loss threshold of the water tiers' entry gates, Large Loss at or above it. The figure starts from nothing: a line family adds a difference only where its pricing sets one, so a job with no line-family difference carries a reassessment figure of 0.00. The total is never below zero and is rounded to the cent, half up, once, on the final figure.

**Rounding.** Half up is applied with a tolerance of one billionth of a dollar (1e-09) added to the floored total before rounding. Line-family differences are added unrounded.

## Assembly, condition by condition

| Total of the line-family differences | Reassessment figure |
|---|---|
| positive | that total, rounded once, half up |
| zero | 0.00 |
| negative | 0.00 (never below zero) |

## Worked figures (hypothetical differences)

- Differences of 214.336 and 57.4 total 271.736, rounded once: **271.74**.
- Differences of 38.10 and minus 52.60 total minus 14.50: **0.00**.
- No difference on any line family: **0.00**.

Affected area, for the tier selection: 1999 square feet is Standard Loss; 2000 square feet is Large Loss.
